title: At-Risk Shopper Segment

storyline.headline: Retention needs a precise outreach list
storyline.summary: QuickCart will contact shoppers only if they are inactive and have a high lifetime value.

objectives: Filter customers using both retention conditions.
starterCode:
import pandas as pd
customers = pd.read_csv('customers.csv')
hints: Use & to combine conditions and wrap each condition in parentheses.
businessInsight: Combining conditions makes intervention lists targeted rather than expensive and broad.

handbook.heading: Combine conditions
handbook.whatItDoes: & keeps rows where both conditions are true; | keeps rows where either is true.
handbook.useCase: Use it to define precise customer, risk, or operational segments.
